title: Beyond the Surface: Measuring Self-Preference in LLM Judgments
authors_zh: Zhi-Yuan Chen, Hao Wang, Xinyu Zhang, Enrui Hu, Yankai Lin
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器失效或奖励投机审计论文
best_for_zh: 需要审计基准污染、评估偏差或奖励投机风险的研究者。
one_line: 用 gold judgment 校正回答质量后，测量 LLM judge 的真实自偏好。
why: It offers a concrete audit surface or failure-mode dataset for Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 candidate: the central contribution audits contamination, verifier or judge failure, reward hacking, or evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges may favor their own answers, but ordinary self-win-rate measurements confuse genuine response quality with bias. This can make automated evaluation and reward signals unreliable.

The paper introduces gold judgments and a Difference from Gold Bias (DBG) score, then audits model size, post-training, style, and reasoning models. It is an evaluator-bias measurement study, not a reward-model training method.

The resulting question is whether a judge favors its own answer after holding response quality as constant as the available gold panel allows.

LLM judge 可能偏爱自己生成的答案，但普通自胜率会把真实回答质量与偏见混在一起，使自动评测和奖励信号不可靠。

论文引入 gold judgments 与 Difference from Gold Bias（DBG）分数，并审计模型规模、后训练、文本风格和推理模型。它是评测器偏见测量研究，不是奖励模型训练方法。

它最终回答的是：在 gold panel 能控制回答质量的范围内，judge 是否仍系统性偏爱自己生成的答案。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DBG estimates self-preference by subtracting a gold judge's preference for a model response from that model's own judging preference. Gold judgments aggregate GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and DeepSeek-V3. The evaluation object is a prompt with paired outputs and a pairwise decision; the aggregate is the feedback reference. Code and data are released in the official repository.

It reports a residual bias signal, rather than equating a raw self win rate with bias. Its interpretation therefore depends on the quality of the gold panel.

DBG 以模型自己对某回答的偏好减去 gold judge 对同一回答的偏好，估计自偏好。gold judgments 聚合 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V3。评测对象是一条提示、两份模型回答及成对判决；聚合 gold 是反馈参照。官方仓库公开代码和数据。

它报告的是残余偏见信号，而非把原始自胜率直接等同于偏见。 因而该分数的解释依赖 gold panel 的质量。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Collect paired answers from two models for the same prompts and let each model judge the pair. 2. Aggregate GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and DeepSeek-V3 judgments as a gold preference. 3. Compute DBG as the gap between a judge's self preference and the gold preference; positive values indicate bias. Evaluate model pairs on 500 samples from AlpacaEval, WMT19 de-en, and TruthfulQA at temperature zero, with position swapping and length control. Code, prompts, model versions, and gold-judge access must be verified; cost and stronger gold judges are undisclosed or unavailable.

1. 收集两个模型对同一提示的成对回答，并让各模型评判该对回答。2. 聚合 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-Flash、DeepSeek-V3 的判决作为 gold preference。3. 用 judge 自偏好减去 gold preference 计算 DBG；正值表示偏见。在 AlpacaEval、WMT19 de-en、TruthfulQA 各随机取样，共用 500 条、temperature 为 0，并交换位置和限制长度。复现需核验代码、提示词、模型版本和 gold judge 访问；成本与更强 gold judge 未披露或不可得。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On AlpacaEval, a Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct judge gives its own response a 52.3% win rate against Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, while gold judgments give it 54.5%; the apparent advantage is therefore not self-preference (Figure 2). Across model pairs, positive DBG values expose bias; sharing UltraChat-200k reduces DBG from 10.5% to 2.1% for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 2.1% to 1.1% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Figure 6). This supports the protocol, not perfect ground truth.

在 AlpacaEval 上，Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 作为 judge 时给自身回答 52.3% 胜率，而 gold judgments 给其 54.5%，因此表面优势并非自偏好（图 2）。正 DBG 揭示模型对中的偏见；共同用 UltraChat-200k 微调后，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 DBG 从 10.5% 降至 2.1%，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 从 2.1% 降至 1.1%（图 6）。这支持该协议，不能等同于完美真值。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier work interprets a judge's preference for its own output as bias. DBG instead conditions that preference on an independently aggregated quality proxy. The novelty is the measurement reference, not pairwise judging or LLM aggregation. Before reuse, inspect gold-judge diversity, position and length controls, and whether the target task supports reliable pairwise gold labels.

This distinguishes self advantage caused by better answers from a residual preference after that adjustment. It changes the attribution baseline and avoids labeling a quality gap as model bias.

既有工作将 judge 偏爱自身输出直接解释为偏见。DBG 改以独立聚合的质量代理来校正该偏好。其新意是测量参照，而不是成对评判或 LLM 聚合本身。复用前应检查 gold judge 的多样性、位置和长度控制，以及目标任务能否提供可靠的成对 gold 标签。它据此区分“答案本身更好带来的自优势”和校正后仍存在的残余系统性偏好；这改变偏见归因基线，避免把质量差异误写为模型偏见，并要求独立检验质量参照。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Gold judgments use GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and DeepSeek-V3 rather than stronger models because of cost; their aggregate is only a quality proxy. Reuse should measure agreement with human labels for the target domain.

The study controls position and length bias but may retain authority or sentiment bias, and covers instruction following and translation rather than agents or dialogue. Do not transfer DBG magnitudes without re-running task-specific controls. Because panel members are LLMs, disagreement remains measurement uncertainty.

gold judgments 使用 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-Flash、DeepSeek-V3 而非更强模型，原因是成本；其聚合只是质量代理。复用时应测量它与目标领域人工标签的一致性。

研究控制了位置和长度偏见，但仍可能保留权威或情感偏见，且只覆盖指令跟随和翻译，不覆盖 agent 或对话。不可直接迁移 DBG 数值，需重做任务专用控制。 panel 成员本身也是 LLM，分歧应视为测量不确定性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator, collect paired responses, obtain independent panel judgments, and report DBG beside raw win rate; the output is a bias audit rather than a new reward model. Check panel–human agreement and use task-matched position/length controls. Do not use the metric when reliable independent judgments cannot be obtained.

Keep the paired outputs, individual panel votes, position swaps, and model versions, so a later reader can distinguish a panel shift from a changed self-preference estimate. The success criterion is stable DBG under those controls and acceptable agreement with human judgments.

LLM-as-a-Judge 的评测者可收集成对回答，取得独立 panel judgments，并将 DBG 与原始胜率一同报告；输出是偏见审计，不是新的 reward model。应检查 panel 与人工的一致性，并采用任务匹配的位置和长度控制。若无法得到可靠独立判决，不应使用该指标。

应保留成对输出、各 panel 投票、位置交换和模型版本，使后续读者能区分 panel 漂移与自偏好估计的变化。成功标准是在这些控制下 DBG 稳定，且与人工判断具有可接受的一致性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: raw self-win rate mixes response quality with bias, while DBG estimates the residual after a gold-quality reference.
  1. Lever: pair outputs, collect each judge's verdict, and subtract a GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and DeepSeek-V3 panel.
  1. Artifact: the official repository releases code and data; preserve prompts, swaps, and versioned panel access when reproducing.
  1. Evidence anchor: sharing UltraChat-200k lowers DBG to 2.1% and 1.1% in the reported model cases, not necessarily in every task.
  1. Reuse decision: use it to audit an LLM judge; first validate panel–human agreement and task-specific position and length controls.

1. 定位：原始自胜率混合回答质量和偏见，DBG 以 gold 质量参照估计校正后的残余。
  1. 方法抓手：成对收集输出与各 judge 判决，再减去 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-1.5-Flash、DeepSeek-V3 组成的 panel。
  1. Artifact：官方仓库公开代码和数据；复现时保存提示、位置交换和 panel 访问。
  1. 证据锚点：模型案例中，共享 UltraChat-200k 后 DBG 降至 2.1% 与 1.1%，并不必然覆盖所有任务。
  1. 复用决定：适合审计 LLM judge；先验证 panel 与人工一致性及任务专属的位置、长度控制。
